name: Dumbbell bench press

phases.name: lower
phases.cue: Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest

phases.name: press
phases.cue: Press straight up over your shoulders

phases.name: lockout
phases.cue: Arms long, back on the bench

formTips: Lie flat with your eyes under where the dumbbells start, feet planted on the floor
Pinch your shoulder blades together and keep them on the bench
Lower the dumbbells slowly to the sides of your chest, elbows about 45–60° from your body
Press up until your arms are straight over your shoulders, without clanking the dumbbells
Keep your head, shoulders and hips on the bench
commonMistakes: Flaring the elbows straight out to the sides
Bouncing the dumbbells at the bottom
Lifting the hips off the bench to push the weight
Letting the dumbbells drift towards the face or the stomach
